specification_points.description: Construct and simplify truth tables for logic circuits
Apply Boolean algebra laws (De Morgan's theorems, absorption, etc.) to simplify expressions
Use Karnaugh maps to simplify Boolean expressions
Describe flip-flops (SR, D, JK) and their use in registers
Describe imperative, object-oriented, declarative, and functional programming paradigms
Understand OOP concepts: classes, objects, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism
Describe declarative programming and logical deduction (Prolog-style)
Understand functional programming: higher-order functions, map, filter, reduce, immutability
Understand the relational data model: tables, primary keys, foreign keys
Write SQL queries: SELECT, FROM, WHERE, JOIN, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE
Understand the role of a DBMS; describe ACID properties of transactions
Describe AI problem-solving approaches: graph traversal (BFS, DFS), A* algorithm
Understand machine learning: training data, supervised vs unsupervised learning
Describe neural networks at a high level: neurons, layers, weights, activation functions
Discuss ethical and social implications of AI
